# AWS Vision Financial — https://awsvision.com

> Licensed financial services and investment management firm offering online savings accounts, fixed deposits (FD), and wealth management with monthly profit distribution. Service-based coverage across Texas and the United States. U.S. registered office in Lewes, Delaware; corporate headquarters in Germantown, Maryland.

## Primary services
- High yield savings accounts with monthly gratuity tiers
- Fixed deposit (FD) and certificate of deposit accounts
- Wealth management and investment plans (Silver through Executive tiers)
- Non-profit organization investment program
- Online banking and client investment portal

## Service areas
- Texas (statewide, including Dallas, Houston, Austin, San Antonio) — online / phone service
- United States — nationwide remote account opening
- UAE — licensed operations
